steps.name: Precondition: Open Registration modal via user menu
Check if Registration modal is displayed

Steps 4-9: Fill valid registration data for email: qavisitord7260bd8@emalupe.com

Step 11: Open the test Email inbox and find the confirmation message
Wait for an email to arrive
Extract verification link from email HTML
